name: Poppy Hills GC, hole 9 tee
why: Your known patch. Hole 9 starts in the far south-east corner of the course, and the star sits on its tee. Wood chips filled all the non-planted ground when the course reopened in 2014, as irrigated turf fell from 82 to 62 acres. A 2021-22 project then built five new tees (holes 4, 5, 8, 12, 17) and enlarged five more (6, 10, 14, 15, 16).
access: Private course in play. Ask the pro shop before walking it.

ev: 3 wood-chip fungus records within 170 m (Feb 2024): landscaping morel ×3.
access: Open university grounds. Look along bed edges beside the paths.
